name: terrar.ai
tagline: Agentic AI characters inside the game Terraria, spawning many agents at once.

awards: Best Use of Grok for Real-Time Data/Signal Analysis by xAI

problem: AI agents had been added to games like chess and Minecraft but not to Terraria.
solution: A game mod that connects AI agents through a model API so many characters act in the sandbox world.
demo_moment: Team-described: spawn 50 agents and watch them fight a boss.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Grok for Real-Time Data/Signal Analysis by xAI” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Putting agents inside a beloved game is instantly watchable.
